description: Source code for a Zephyr driver implementing a simple SPI controller interface for the opencores_spi_simple hardware, including configuration, transceive, and initialization functions.

methods.name: spi_oc_simple_configure
methods.description: Configures the SPI controller based on provided configuration, setting mode and clock divider.

methods.name: spi_oc_simple_transceive
methods.description: Performs SPI data transfer synchronously, handling chip select and data buffers.

methods.name: spi_oc_simple_transceive_async
methods.description: Stub for asynchronous transceive, not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: spi_oc_simple_release
methods.description: Releases the SPI device, unlocking context.

methods.name: spi_oc_simple_init
methods.description: Initializes the SPI device, setting up control registers and context.
